summary: An AnsibleJob sets connection_secret and job_template_name (or workflow_template_name), plus optional inventory and extra_vars (need Prompt on launch), runner_image, runner_version, job_ttl, job_tags and skip_tags.
questions: How do I pass extra_vars in an AnsibleJob?
How do I launch a workflow template with AnsibleJob?

answer_card.title: Launch a job with AnsibleJob
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: tower.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleJob
metadata:
  generateName: demo-job-1
spec:
  connection_secret: aap-access
  job_template_name: Demo Job Template   # or workflow_template_name
  inventory: Demo Inventory              # needs Prompt on launch
  extra_vars:                            # needs Prompt on launch
    test_var: test
  job_tags: "provision,install"
  skip_tags: "restart"
  job_ttl: 100
```
